title: Governance onboarding & release orchestra for RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS (Private/VPC)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Why: Customers deploying Redwood private/VPC require clear governance controls (RBAC), immutable audit trails, and customer-managed key workflows (KMS). This initiative coordinates release-level artifacts and cross-team enablement so the new controls land with minimal friction for enterprise customers and internal GTM teams.

Scope: RBAC role model and Console UX changes; audit log formatting, retention, and export; KMS integration patterns (encryption at rest + key rotation guidance); release notes, migration guidance, sales/SE enablement, and support runbooks. Does NOT include on-prem installer changes beyond optional flags (those are tracked in ENG-3011).

Goals:
- Deliver a complete release bundle (docs, release notes, training, dashboards) for private-2026.03.
- Ensure Security & Legal sign-off on audit semantics and KMS customer responsibility language.
- Provide customers and Sales with migration checklist and post-upgrade observability KPIs.
acceptance_criteria: PRD updated with final RBAC matrix, audit schema, and KMS flow diagrams
Console UX copy + screenshots approved by Design and included in release notes
Release notes drafted, editorially approved, and staged in /docs/release-notes/private-2026.03
Enablement materials for Sales/Support: slide deck, FAQ, one-pager migration checklist
Security review completed and signed by Security (tickets logged), and legal-approved customer text for KMS responsibilities
Support runbook and rollback procedure published in Confluence
Monitoring dashboard (latency, failed auths, audit export success rate) created and linked to the release
